facts.fact: Adwave's campaigns start from $30 per day with no contracts, according to its own homepage callout.
Adwave's related guide on towing company advertising says budgets look like from $30 per day.
According to Adwave, TikTok ads run only after the user turns TikTok on in Customize and connects a TikTok account; other channels are Facebook, Instagram, Google, Reddit, web, mobile, and TV.
facts.quote: TikTok runs when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account
